text: Because the SEC is still working out the appropriate use of Form PF and still improving the form and its instructions, its enforcement division is unlikely to open investigations into alleged misreporting or failures to report.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Hedge Funds’ Systemic Risk Disclosures in Bankruptcy (2013). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2348463
